name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  fmt:
    name: Rustfmt
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/rustfmt@v1

  clippy:
    name: Clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          components: clippy
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets

  test:
    name: Rust Test (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      - run: cargo test --workspace

  python-build:
    name: Python build (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install maturin
        run: pip install maturin
      - name: Build wheel
        run: maturin build --release --out dist
      - name: Install package and test deps
        run: |
          pip install dist/*.whl pytest pytest-asyncio
      - name: Smoke test
        run: |
          cd /tmp && python -c "from mem7 import Memory; print('import OK')"
      - name: Run Python tests
        run: |
          cd /tmp && pytest "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tests/python/test_memory.py"

  python-style:
    name: Python style
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install ruff
        run: pip install ruff
      - name: Check formatting
        run: ruff format --check mem7 tests/python
      - name: Lint
        run: ruff check mem7 tests/python

  node-build:
    name: Node.js build (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: src/bindings/mem7-node
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - run: npm install
      - name: Build native module
        run: npx napi build -p mem7-node --platform --release
      - name: Smoke test
        run: node -e "const m = require('./index.js'); console.log('MemoryEngine:', typeof m.MemoryEngine)"

  openclaw-plugin-build:
    name: OpenClaw plugin build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/openclaw-mem7
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - run: npm install --ignore-scripts
      - name: Prettier check
        run: npm run fmt:check
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint
      - name: TypeScript compile
        run: npx -p typescript tsc --noEmit
      - name: Build dist
        run: npm run build

[package]
name = "mem7-llm"
version.workspace = true

[dependencies]

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # ── Build Python wheels for all platforms ──────────────────────────
  build-wheels:
    name: Build wheels (${{ matrix.target }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            sdist: true
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            manylinux: "2_24"
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Build wheels
        uses: PyO3/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          args: --release --out dist ${{ matrix.sdist && '--sdist' || '' }}
          manylinux: ${{ matrix.manylinux || 'auto' }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: wheels-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist

  # ── Build Node.js native addons for all platforms ──────────────────
  build-node:
    name: Build node (${{ matrix.target }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: src/bindings/mem7-node
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          cache: false
      - run: npm install
      - name: Build native module
        run: npx napi build -p mem7-node --platform --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ contains(matrix.target, 'linux') && '--use-napi-cross' || '' }}
        env:
          CFLAGS_aarch64_unknown_linux_gnu: "-D__ARM_ARCH=8"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: node-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: src/bindings/mem7-node/mem7.*.node
          if-no-files-found: error

  # ── Publish Python package to PyPI ─────────────────────────────────
  publish-pypi:
    name: Publish to PyPI
    needs: [build-wheels]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/project/mem7/
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: wheels-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: dist
      - name: Publish to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          verbose: true
          skip-existing: true

  # ── Publish Node.js package to npm ─────────────────────────────────
  publish-npm:
    name: Publish to npm
    needs: [build-node]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: src/bindings/mem7-node
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm install
      - name: Download all native artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: node-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: src/bindings/mem7-node/artifacts
      - name: Prepare and publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          npx napi create-npm-dirs
          npx napi artifacts
          for dir in npm/*/; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
              npm publish "$dir" --access public || true
            fi
          done
          npm publish --access public --ignore-scripts

  # ── Publish OpenClaw plugin to npm ───────────────────────────────
  publish-openclaw-plugin:
    name: Publish OpenClaw plugin to npm
    needs: [publish-npm]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/openclaw-mem7
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm install --ignore-scripts
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Publish to npm
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm publish --access public || echo "⚠ openclaw-mem7 skipped (already published or error)"

  # ── Publish Rust crates to crates.io ───────────────────────────────
  publish-crates:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    needs: [publish-pypi]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          cache: false
      - name: Publish crates (dependency order)
        run: |
          set -e
          publish() {
            echo "Publishing $1..."
            cargo publish -p "$1" --allow-dirty || echo "⚠ $1 skipped (already published or error)"
            sleep 15
          }
          publish mem7-error
          publish mem7-datetime
          publish mem7-config
          publish mem7-core
          publish mem7-llm
          publish mem7-embedding
          publish mem7-vector
          publish mem7-history
          publish mem7-dedup
          publish mem7-reranker
          publish mem7-graph
          publish mem7-telemetry
          publish mem7-store
          publish mem7

[build-system]
build-backend = "maturin"
requires = ["maturin>=1.5,<2"]

[project]
name = "mem7"
version = "0.3.3"
description = "High-performance AI memory engine with Rust core"
readme = "README.md"
license = {file = "LICENSE"}
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
    "pydantic>=2.0",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/mem7ai/mem7"
Repository = "https://github.com/mem7ai/mem7"

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.24",
    "ruff",
]

[tool.maturin]
manifest-path = "src/bindings/mem7-python/Cargo.toml"
python-source = "."
module-name = "mem7._mem7"
features = []

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py310"
line-length = 100

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E4", "E7", "E9", "F"]
